design.freshSeedRule: serverSeed = sha256(label) as lowercase hex; clientSeed = label

pass1.seeds: each difficulty on its own seed labels
pass1.survival: k lanes survive iff the smallest trap slot is >= k
pass1.serialStatistic: pick 0 slot of every round in census order; upper = 2·slot ≥ 25

pass2.earlyWindow: nonces 1 … n, n = the rounds the capture played on the seed
pass2.slot: nonce i plays the (i − 1) mod n-th captured round of the seed in nonce order: its difficulty (m traps), walked to the lanes K it named (auto) or planned to cash out at (lane by lane); win iff no trap is among slots 0 … K − 1
pass2.units: byCell = per difficulty/lanes [rounds, wins]; Phase A epochs also carry the pooled return: ret12 = sum of floor(multiplier·10^12) over wins; meanD = sum of mult12·(25−m)·(D/25); varD2 = sum of mult12²·(25−m)·m·(D/25)²; D = 25
